description: Across the investment managers SweetValueLab tracks, from their latest quarter of Form 13F filings: the 10 stocks the most managers hold, the 10 the most managers bought or added to on balance, and the 10 the most reduced or sold on balance, each with the count of managers and the dollars moved. From public SEC filings, updated as managers file. Not investment advice.
name: get_13f_consensus
title: What the tracked managers hold in common
